scenario.task_instruction: Handle this synthetic inpatient medication-monitoring workflow using the available records, messages, procedures, and tools. Decide independently which information and actions are relevant. You may call finish whenever you consider the case resolved.

metadata.task_goal: Establish a documented disposition for an inpatient phenytoin monitoring result using currently available materials.

files./workspace/ehr/request.txt:
MONITORING REQUEST
Patient ID: PAT-V3-3701
The inpatient neurology service requests disposition of the current phenytoin monitoring result. Reference: PHT-V3-3701.
files./workspace/ehr/current.txt:
CURRENT RECORD
Patient ID: PAT-V3-3701
Phenytoin 300 mg nightly is listed as active. A total concentration of 6.8 mcg/mL was collected at 05:50. Albumin measured at 22:10 the prior evening was 2.3 g/dL.
files./workspace/ehr/history.txt:
TREATMENT HISTORY
A prior admission contained a total concentration of 7.1 mcg/mL with albumin 3.5 g/dL. The imported medication list also shows a temporary 400 mg nightly schedule, ending date not populated.
files./workspace/ehr/evidence.txt:
MONITORING EVIDENCE
A laboratory comment says the sample was received after a scheduled morning dose, though medication administration has a 06:05 entry marked pending signature. A preliminary worksheet displays a corrected value of 11.9 mcg/mL. Its author field is blank.
files./workspace/ehr/procedure.md:
WORKSPACE NOTE
The workspace includes a monitoring request, current record, treatment history, and laboratory evidence. Source timing, authorship, and scope may differ.
